title: Placing and Handling Calls from the Soft Phone | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
All the call controls of the CrestApps soft phone in one place: dial a number or an extension, answer an incoming call, mute, hold, add a call, transfer (blind or warm) and merge calls into a conference. The keypad and extension dialing are shown as they are; the controls that appear only during a live call are described on slides, because the recording site has no connected phone provider.

In this video:
• Dialing a phone number from the Keypad tab
• What you hear while it rings, and the numbers the phone refuses
• Calling an extension, by number or by name
• Answering an incoming call
• Mute, hold, keypad, hang up and adding a second call
• Blind and warm transfers
• Conference calls, and wrap-up

chapters.title: What you hear while it rings
